DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian carcinoma with malignant ascites.

(Note: The patient is a 40-year-old nulliparous woman presenting with shortness of breath, increased abdominal girth, and a large ovarian mass. These are classic signs of advanced ovarian cancer where the tumor produces ascitic fluid causing respiratory distress. Given the high probability of malignancy in this demographic with these specific symptoms, further imaging is critical to confirm the extent of disease before proceeding to treatment.)
